title: GIR Data-Point Completeness Analyzer
description: Declare the GloBE Information Return data points your own systems can populate, together with the facts that switch conditional points on, and get back a per-point map of populated, partial and missing entries plus a coverage figure over the declared inventory. The data-point structure is taken from the OECD GloBE Information Return (January 2025), Annex A1, at the granularity of that publication's own numbered sub-tables. Readiness mapping only: it does not compose a return, does not render GIR XML, and never states that a return may be submitted.

declared_inventory.description: Data points the filer declares they can populate: [{id, status}] where status is populated, partial or missing. Anything absent is treated as missing.

declared_facts.description: Boolean facts declared by the filer that make conditional data points applicable, e.g. sh_tcbcr, transition_year, qdmtt, iir, utpr, initial_phase, intl_shipping.

gir_schema_version.description: The GIR structure the inventory was mapped against. A declared, versioned input, never a fixed constant.

reporting_fiscal_year_label.description: Free-text label for the Reporting Fiscal Year, echoed back only.

coverage_over_declared_inventory_pct.description: Populated over applicable, as a percentage. A coverage count over the declared inventory, never a readiness verdict.

unrecognised_references.description: Input references that matched no data point in the declared structure, reported rather than silently dropped.

points.description: Per data point: reference, label, requirement (always or conditional), the named condition, whether the condition was declared, applicability, and declared status.

mcp_tool_definition.name: analyze_gir_data_point_completeness
mcp_tool_definition.description: Maps a filer-declared data inventory against the GloBE Information Return (January 2025) Annex A1 data-point structure and reports which points are populated, partial, missing, or not applicable, naming the condition behind every conditional point. Returns a coverage count over the declared inventory. Does not compose a GIR, does not render GIR XML, and does not evaluate any amount.

declared_inventory.description: [{id, status}] with status populated, partial or missing

declared_facts.description: Boolean facts that switch conditional data points on
